title: Delegation token claims (fabric-delegation/0.1, DEC-0039)
description: The decoded payload of a delegation token: a JWT (RFC 7519) signed by the estate hub with Ed25519 (alg EdDSA, RFC 8037), shaped as OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (RFC 8693). The protected header is $defs/header. The issuer emits exactly these claims; a verifier ignores claims it does not know (RFC 7519 §4).

iss.description: The estate hub that signed the token; stable across key rotation and port changes (urn:fabric:estate:<estate id>).

sub.description: The principal: the person of the estate on whose behalf the work runs (the operator, or an external person under a share grant).

act.description: RFC 8693 §4.1 actor chain: the agent now calling outermost, each earlier agent nested inside, at most four deep.

aud.description: Exactly one callee agent id, as a string, never an array.

scope.description: RFC 8693 §4.2: space-delimited capability names (tool names) of the callee.

effect.description: The effect ceiling: the classes admitted, with none below every class and draft below every external class.

grant.description: Opaque references of the grant(s) the call is under; a usage report's byGrant repeats them.

spend.description: What the grant had left when the token was minted. Informative: the meter's grant check decides, not this claim.

project.description: Present when the grant is bound to a project.

task.description: DEC-0041: the issuing host's task the work runs under, set by the hub when the session or run has one; the meter keys the task window on it. An onward token keeps the parent's task or none, never another.

session.description: An opaque id of the session the actor runs in, when it runs in one.

task.description: An opaque id of the issuing host's task, in the session id's grammar (DEC-0041).

actor4.description: The fourth actor is the last: it carries no act.
